title: Branching grows the work at deeper graph levels
method: Synthetic acyclic tree has branching factor 3 and no shared descendants. Nodes at depth d equal 3^d:3,9,27,81; total through depth 4 is 120 excluding root. Real graphs have cycles, skew and overlap; this is not a database benchmark.
alt: Branching grows the work at deeper graph levels. Depth 1: 3 nodes at depth; Depth 2: 9 nodes at depth; Depth 3: 27 nodes at depth; Depth 4: 81 nodes at depth. Illustrative values.
